newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end higher in light trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end higher in light trade.

text.p: April 18 - U.S. stock index futures ended higher in extremely light trade. Some traders said April options expiration contributed to June S&Ps' firm tone. June S&Ps rose to 773.00, near major trendline resistance at 774.00 to 774.50. Traders said strong gains in Microsoft, and the recovery in T-bonds, lifted most contracts.
